title: T1608.006 — Stage Capabilities - SEO Poisoning
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Stage Capabilities - SEO Poisoning with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker compromises small websites, generates cloaked doorway pages, and poisons search results. A finance employee clicks a poisoned result, downloads a ZIP from a fake forum, and the SOC isolates the host, blocks the staging network, and reports the farm.

nodes.label: Attacker
nodes.tip: The threat actor. Prepares the whole setup long before any victim appears.

nodes.label: Blog farm
nodes.tip: Hundreds of small websites running an outdated CMS. They host the doorway pages and the fake forum.

nodes.label: Search engine
nodes.tip: The search engine is used as the delivery channel. It ranks the poisoned pages without knowing.

nodes.label: Finance employee
nodes.tip: The victim searches for a work document and clicks a poisoned result. She never receives an email.

nodes.label: SOC analyst
nodes.tip: The defender. Joins proxy referer chains with EDR script alerts to expose the staging network.

steps.title: Compromise small websites
steps.caption: The attacker breaks into hundreds of small websites that run an outdated CMS (content management system - the software many blogs are built on) and turns them into a quiet farm of ready-made hosting.
steps.defender: Defacement and scan alerts fire on a few of these victims, but most compromises stay silent. Nothing inside your network is touched yet.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Generate doorway pages
steps.caption: The attacker generates thousands of doorway pages - pages built only to rank in search results - whose titles mirror the phrases professionals really type, like a policy template plus a city name.
steps.defender: Search crawlers begin indexing the new pages. Sitemap files announce every new URL so the indexing happens faster.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Add cloaking logic
steps.caption: Cloaking means showing different content to different visitors. Each doorway page now shows the fake forum only to people arriving from the search engine in the target country, once per person. Everyone else sees harmless text.
steps.defender: Automated scanners that visit directly see the harmless page. That is why reputation services and crawlers stay quiet about the real content.

steps.title: Submit sitemaps and wait
steps.caption: Sitemaps are submitted and the farm waits. Over the following weeks the doorway pages climb the rankings for long-tail phrases that almost nobody else targets. This is the quiet month.
steps.defender: Nothing is visible from your side yet. Only outside-in monitoring of your own estate and passive DNS of the farm offers any early signal.

steps.title: Victim searches and clicks
steps.caption: A finance employee searches for a policy template with a city name and clicks a top result - a genuine-looking blog she has never visited before. The poisoned result did the delivery work.
steps.defender: The proxy records the search-engine referer (the address of the page the user clicked from) pointing at a long-tail blog. First internal evidence appears.

steps.title: Fake forum recommends a ZIP
steps.caption: The cloaking check passes, so she sees a fake forum thread that repeats her search phrase in the title. Several invented accounts discuss the problem and agree on one attached ZIP file.
steps.defender: No alert yet. The page looks like an ordinary community discussion to every filter, and the domain has no bad reputation so far.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Download and execution
steps.caption: She downloads the ZIP and opens the file inside. Obfuscated JavaScript - script text scrambled to hide its purpose - runs through Windows Script Host and installs a loader.
steps.defender: EDR alerts: Windows Script Host executing a script from the Downloads folder. The chain from poisoned result to code execution is complete.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: SOC response
steps.caption: The SOC isolates the workstation, blocks the staging network - five sibling domains found on the same hosting IP - and reports the farm to the search engine and the hoster.
steps.defender: Hunting finds one earlier click from last week that never executed. The search engine delists the poisoned results within days of the report.
